'''Super Wallets''' are a type of DVD package that were released by {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) for {{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}. Magna Pacific began releasing Pokémon Super Wallets to celebrate the [[Pokémon 10th Anniversary]]. Super Wallets were released for [[season]]s [[S01|1]] to [[S09|9]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}, with each [[season]] having discs designed to resemble a certain [[Poké Ball]]. Some Super Wallets also included a bonus disc (which was designed to resemble a [[Premier Ball]]), containing either episodes of [[Pokémon Chronicles]] or ''[[The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon]]''. These sets include a collectors' disc wallet containing the discs, as well as a booklet with descriptions of the episodes. In Region 4 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to standard [[season]]s (in the same way as on [[Pokémon.com]]), rather than by [[Viz Media]] season (as seen in Region 1 releases).
